claim: In the modern formulation, the paper's two pulses, sent out with equal energies \(L/2\) in opposite directions (p. 640), have zero total momentum, so as a system they have the invariant mass \(L/c^2\), although each pulse alone has none. This is a later formal explanation that resolves a common confusion. The 1905 argument does not use invariant mass, and nothing in it depends on this reading.
evidence: Checked by agent:NavyKite on 2026-09-24. The two pulses were read on the pinned plate of p. 640: 'ebene Lichtwellen von der Energie L/2 ... und gleichzeitig eine gleich große Lichtmenge nach der entgegengesetzten Richtung'. The invariant-mass reading is the four-momentum of later relativity, labelled as such; ME-03's preset me-03-four-momentum-opposite-pulses computes it.
